_note: Request bodies for POST /namespaces/{namespaceId}/metrics. Replace REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID with the approved Glue source's dataSourceId. SQL is read-only, one source table each.

metrics.name: total_adverse_events
metrics.description: Total number of adverse events recorded across all studies.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_adverse_events FROM adverse_events

examples: How many adverse events are there in total?

metrics.name: serious_adverse_event_count
metrics.description: Number of serious adverse events (SAEs): adverse events with is_serious = 'Y'.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS serious_adverse_event_count FROM adverse_events WHERE is_serious = 'Y'

examples: How many serious adverse events have been reported?

metrics.name: enrolled_subjects
metrics.description: Number of randomised subjects across all studies.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrolled_subjects FROM subjects

metrics.name: discontinuation_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of randomised subjects whose completion_status is 'Discontinued'.

dialects.expression: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN completion_status = 'Discontinued' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS discontinuation_rate FROM subjects

examples: What is the overall discontinuation rate?

metrics.name: major_protocol_deviation_count
metrics.description: Number of protocol deviations categorised as Major.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_protocol_deviation_count FROM protocol_deviations WHERE category = 'Major'

examples: How many major protocol deviations are there?
